jobs.title: Cloud Engineer Automation
jobs.desc:
Working for a company like Smile Digital Health means supporting our mandate for #BetterGlobalHealth . We strive towards this goal every day, and the results can be seen in the impact of our innovative health data platform and data management solutions, which are used in over 20 countries. We were #19 on Deloitte's Technology Fast 50 Ranking for 2024! Smile Digital Health makes it easy for healthcare stakeholders to collect and exchange data with our leading FHIR-based data liberation platform. At its heart, the Smile platform enables people and organizations to better manage healthcare data. We help generate and liberate structured healthcare data to ensure effective delivery across care teams and health systems bringing #BetterGlobalHealth to patients everyday! Apply today and find plenty of reasons to SMILE! The Cloud Engineer (Automation) is responsible for designing, building, operating and improving production-grade automation for Smile Digital Health, its clients and partners. This role will be responsible for the pipelines, infrastructure as code, environments and recovery procedures, that the platform runs on. This Engineer will merge direct platform engineering expertise with driving strategic changes in how the department designs, deploys, and maintains its infrastructure. Key responsibilities include managing build and release engineering, orchestrating the Terraform and Helm infrastructure, provisioning on-demand environments, and implementing automated recovery. This role works closely with Platform Engineering, Solution Engineering, Service Operations and Engineering Practice QA to remove unnecessary repetitive, manual work and effectively optimize a build from the time the client commits to a running environment faster, decrease platform costs, and utilize AI to enhance the platformâs engineering and operations. 
 Responsibilities: Own build and release engineering by reviewing the current repositories and CI setup, then consolidate duplicated Azure DevOps pipeline YAML onto shared reusable templates with change detection and automated quality gates. Identify and eliminate manual efforts for cross-functional teams and replace them with scheduled, auditable automation. For example, automating patching, certificate and secret rotation, environment scaling, and recurring reports Implement GitOps-based continuous delivery - declarative, Git-driven deployments with automated reconciliation, drift detection and rollback. Automate line-of-business environments end to end, provisioned and torn down on demand across every Azure service and application involved. Automate business continuity and disaster recovery through backup validation, restore and failover, recurring DR drills, and measured RTO and RPO. Ensure Helm and Terraform are easy to upgrade by charting reuse and configuration validation, versioned modules, and state boundaries that limit how far an upgrade reaches. Run in-cluster platform services deployed through Helm, harden workloads for availability and capacity: health probes, replica counts, and right-sized requests, limits and autoscaling. Ensure that the Terraform configuration is regularly maintained. Build and maintain Build Agent images for streamlining tooling available for the builds. Automate the guardrails such as policy-as-code, security and IaC scanning in the pipeline, and alerts and dashboards defined as code. Implement AI-assisted engineering in the platform teamâs day-to-day work Contribute to the departmentâs AI enablement, package knowledge into reusable skills and runbooks in the shared skill library. Work with the development and operations teams to find automation gaps, prioritize them, and close them. Troubleshoot production and staging issues and document what you automate so others can operate it. Requirements: 6+ years of hands-on cloud engineering, DevOps and/or platform engineering experience, including at least 1-2+ years with infrastructure as code and CI/CD automation on Microsoft Azure in production. Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Engineering, or similar and/or equivalent work experience. Practical in-depth knowledge and expertise in Terraform, Helm and Azure DevOps pipelines, and GitOps delivery (Argo CD or Flux). Strong Terraform skills including, but not limited to, experience with module design, provider version management, state management and refactoring. Expertise in Helm chart authoring and refactoring, including recent experience with Kubernetes and AKS. Demonstrated knowledge across Azure (AKS, Key Vault, Storage, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, networking, identity) and observability as code (Azure Monitor and/or Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry). Hands-on experience automating backup, restore and failover with measured RTO and RPO. Hands-on experience with agentic coding tools (Claude Code or equivalent), keeping confidential data out of them and reviewing what they produce. Hands-on experience running, hardening and right-sizing production workloads on Kubernetes Hands-on Kafka operations: topic and partition design, consumer group sizing, and throughput and latency trade-offs. Experience migrating between Kafka platforms (HDInsight, Confluent, MSK or self-managed) is a strong asset. Strong Python and Bash skills, able to build maintainable tooling, not glue scripts. A demonstrable record of replacing manual processes with automation. FinOps practice and Azure Cost Management, an asset. Regulated environment experience (healthcare, PHI), an asset. Certifications: HashiCorp Terraform Associate; Microsoft AZ-104, AZ-400, AZ-305; CKA or CKAD, an asset. Observability as code with Azure Monitor, Grafana, Prometheus, or OpenTelemetry; Azure cost optimization, an asset. 
 $120,000 - $140,000 a year

All hiring decisions are ultimately made by qualified human decision-makers, and AI tools are used to support â not replace â fair and equitable hiring practices. This position is a new role, created to support Smileâs continued growth and commitment to operational excellence. Some of the benefits we offer: * Remote Work Environment * Flexible Time Away From Work Policy including PTO, Personal and Sick Days * Competitive Salary and Health/Medical Benefits * RRSP/TFSA/401K Employee Contribution * Life and Disability * Employee Assistance Program * FHIR Study Program and Skillsoft Learning * Super HAPI Fun Club Smile's core values include respect, inclusion, embracing our differences, and celebrating shared values because our people are the foundation of our success. We are big on creating a sense of belonging and empowering each other to bring our authentic selves to work. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace that values diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Candidates are encouraged to inform us if they wish to discuss or require accommodations during interviews or while working at Smile. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit a class= c-link href= http://www.redditinc.com/ target= _blank data-stringify-link= http://redditinc.com data-sk= tooltip_parent www.redditinc.com /a . /div /div /div /div /div /div /div p strong Location: /strong Reddit has a flexible first workforce. Don t live near our office? No worries: you can work remotely from anywhere in the UK or the Netherlands. /p p The strong Ads Foundational Representations (AFR) /strong team develops signals and representations of Reddit’s core entities (ads, posts, users, and so on), capturing the semantic, contextual, and behavioral information that Reddit Ads needs. We work on building embeddings to understand content and users interests based on the content they engage with. nbsp; /p p Our team has the potential to highlight one of Reddit s biggest differentiators: genuinely curated, high-quality, extremely relevant, and daily updated organic content. We are a Machine Learning/Data heavy team with a focus on the following areas: /p ul li strong Multimodal amp; Content Embeddings /strong - Make sense of organic (posts, comments, subreddits) and promoted (ads, shopping products, their landing pages) text and media content by embedding them into a shared space. nbsp; /li li strong Contextual and Behavioral Relevance /strong - Working with Product amp; Data Science, establishing definitions of what ads are relevant to users and the content we show them next to, building metrics and fine-tuning embeddings to better reflect relevance. /li li strong Knowledge Graph Embeddings - /strong Building representations for the Knowledge graph entities, e.g., intellectual properties/brands, to be used for high-precision targeting amp; business insights. nbsp; /li li strong User Intent Modeling - /strong Leveraging various techniques to introduce user representations based on the content they interact with: batch amp; real-time sequence modeling, LLM summarization, etc. nbsp; /li li strong LLM-based Representations /strong - Leveraging LLMs, VLMs, and foundational models to build complex representations of Reddit entities that improve ranking outcomes /li /ul p The signals and features we create become a key piece in the Ads Delivery funnel, from targeting to the auction, as well as the Business Insights product and other advertiser-facing products such as Creative generation and optimization. /p p As a strong Staff ML Engineer /strong , you’ll be in charge of setting the technical direction of multiple pillars the team owns. You will lead cross-functional ML projects end to end - from high-level business gap analysis to engineering execution. nbsp; /p p Roughly 50% of your time will be spent on technical leadership and mentorship (driving strategy amp; designs, cross-functional collaboration, raising the quality bar), another 50% being individual hands-on work (data analysis amp; engineering, modeling amp; automation). nbsp; nbsp; /p p strong Responsibilities /strong /p ul li Providing technical leadership and mentorship to MLEs in the team: driving designs amp; their review, establishing best practices in analysis, modeling and engineering, keeping the bar high. nbsp; /li li Working closely with team/org leadership developing technical strategy for content-based embeddings amp; relevance for Ads. /li li Developing new or iterating on existing embedding models for advertising use cases, ranging from aggregation pipelines to two-tower architectures and sequence models. nbsp; nbsp; /li li Working with local and 3rd-party LLMs/VLMs: extract representations, develop evaluation methodologies, prompt tune and fine-tune large models to build state-of-the-art embeddings. nbsp; /li li Building data processing and inference pipelines for the models we develop. nbsp; /li li Qualitative and quantitative evaluation of the various features we develop, end-to-end experimentation from internal benchmarks to downstream recommender system offline metrics to online experiments. nbsp; /li li Ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of the ML systems by writing automated tests, monitoring performance, and implementing best practices for model management. /li li Participating in modeling and coding reviews: You will review work by other team members and provide feedback to ensure that it meets the team s standards for quality and performance. /li li Collaborating with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions. /li /ul p strong Required Qualifications: /strong /p ul li 7+ years of hands-on experience with the full lifecycle of designing, training, evaluating, testing, and deploying industry-level models. /li li Demonstrated Staff-level technical leadership: mentoring engineers, driving standards and bar raising, leading complex cross-functional projects: from requirements, design to cross-team/functional alignment and execution without direct people-management authority. nbsp; jobs.desc: p SumUp is already live in 38 markets and still growing. Our Global Expansion Team takes SumUp s payment products into new countries, with Mexico and Canada among our most recent launches and more markets like New Zealand and Argentina on the way. As a QA Engineer in our Berlin payments team, you ll build the automated and manual tests that decide when a new card reader can go live in a market, across frontend, backend and mobile flows, and you ll also help complete L3 certification (the final round of testing that acquiring banks and card networks require). It s hands-on engineering work with real launch impact, because your tests help new markets go live and recently launched ones stay stable, so small businesses there can take card payments with confidence. /p h3 strong What you ll do /strong /h3 ul li Build and maintain frontend and backend test automation, with mobile where relevant, and add targeted regression tests to continuous integration (CI) workflows so market specific checks run consistently after code changes /li li Test SumUp products across markets, with a mix of automated and manual testing, functional, integration and regression checks, plus edge cases and recovery scenarios. /li li Spot ways to improve how we test, explain why they matter and make a convincing case for the changes with the biggest payoff /li li Trace failures through complex payment flows using logs and transaction traces, then raise clear, prioritised defects and work with engineers and external partners until they re fixed /li li Own the testing of end-to-end communication between a payment terminal, software applications, and an acquiring network. with acquiring banks and card networks, and keep the team informed on certification status, quality risks and release readiness so launch decisions rest on evidence /li li Work closely in collaboration with engineers, product and market-launch teams, as well as acquirers, card schemes and certification labs. /li /ul h3 strong What you ll bring /strong /h3 ul li Programming or scripting skill to build and maintain automated tests for frontend web and backend APIs, and both manually and with automation, including turning requirements into test scenarios and deciding what to automate first based on customer, launch and technical risk. /li li Ability to analyse logs, jobs.title: Software / Full-Stack QA Engineer
jobs.desc: 🌊 Who are we? We're a smart hydration company rebuilding an industry that still runs on sugar water and single-use packaging. Filtered water, functional flavors, zero bottles. Still, sparkling, cold, and hot. All poured from one tap. We create hydration people want to reach for, starting with the workplace where we help teams thrive. As an AI-native company, we build at speed. In 2025, Aquablu ranked 2nd in the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 (Netherlands) and 30th in the Sifted 250 (Europe), both rankings of the fastest-growing companies by revenue growth. In 2026 we were named a winner of Maya's Culture 100 Europe Awards as one of the best workplaces to thrive in. Growing that fast and thriving comes down to our people. Our team is our biggest asset and one that we're proud of. We're committed to maintaining our vibrant culture as we continue to grow. The Role You'll own software quality across AURA, our mobile app, cloud services, and internal tooling. That covers the whole chain: from a REFILL+ or Aquablu BOLD system generating telemetry, through the data pipeline and our central database, to the screen a partner or client looks at. You decide what must be tested. Our QA Automation Pipeline Engineer builds the framework to run it, and you test directly wherever automation isn't in place yet. The engineers own the software; you own the confidence that it works. What You'll Do Own test strategy, test design, and QA execution across AURA, the mobile app, cloud services, and internal tooling. Test frontend and UI behavior, backend and API correctness, integrations, and end-to-end flows on web and mobile. Set up automated regression for the weekly release, together with the QA Automation Pipeline Engineer. Build contract tests that confirm REFILL+ and Aquablu BOLD telemetry lands correctly in our central database.
